amendment.design: Original selected config, original 24 fixed candidates, then seeded independent log-uniform draws within the amended bounds, up to exactly 128 configurations.
amendment.evaluation_order: August first, September once after all selected models are frozen. Instrument models evaluate their own instrument; pooled model evaluates both. Outputs are retained irrespective of failure.
amendment.gate: Unchanged DEFAULT_GATE from original protocols, including maximum family error 0.60. No threshold changes, no strategy-result optimization.
amendment.reason: All initial July fits failed. Broaden the train-only parameter search and lengthen simulation before opening August or September observations.
amendment.selection: Minimize largest family error plus 10 times invalid simulation fraction, then mean family error; confirm the eight screening finalists on fresh training-only simulator seeds and select by the same fixed criterion.
amendment.stop_rule: One bounded amended search per cohort. Freeze all models before August extraction. No further model change after validation or holdout. Failed gates remain failed.
amendment.training_sources: Only the original frozen July training summaries and source files; no August or September observations have been extracted.

limitations: L2 does not identify FIFO queues, hidden liquidity, or individual arrivals/cancellations.
Amounts map to synthetic lots using each instrument's training-only median top-five side depth.
The mapping does not convert inverse contracts to shares or linear monetary P&L.
Snapshot OFI is a one-second best-quote proxy, not event-by-event exchange OFI.
Book-walk impact excludes replenishment and is not an estimated causal market-impact function.
One representative tick geometry may fail for instruments with different relative tick sizes.
Calibration PASS is an observable-distribution diagnostic, not counterfactual fill validation.
